groups.blurb: The tree, overview, panes, themes, and terminal widths.

groups.title: Provenance hubs
groups.blurb: Pull requests and the activity feed.

groups.title: Source trail
groups.blurb: Repos, commits, files, diffs, and empty states.

groups.title: Dialogs and forms
groups.blurb: Create, edit, prove, confirm, export, update, and overlays.

groups.title: CLI and setup
groups.blurb: The shell surfaces that share the same journal.

scenes.title: Empty journal
scenes.description: The first-run shell with no plans: the tree, preview, agents, and git panes each explain the next action.
lookFor: Do the three empty panes read as one instruction or three competing ones?
Is the create hint obvious at the width you use?
Does the status line earn its space?

scenes.title: Plan overview
scenes.description: The plan overview: health strip, why and what, approval drift, an open question, references, milestones, acceptance, and the next tasks.
lookFor: Scan order from health, to scope, to milestones.
Whether the approval drift line is understandable without the diff.
How much of the preview is visible before scrolling.
scenes.keys: j/k select · s status · e edit · c commands

scenes.title: Milestone overview
scenes.description: A milestone selection: slice health, the milestone description, its tasks with claims and blocks, acceptance, and linked source.
lookFor: Does the milestone feel like a slice rather than a folder?
Are task claims and blocks readable at a glance?
Is the breadcrumb enough to know where you are?
scenes.keys: j/k select · z fold · s status

scenes.title: Task overview
scenes.description: A task selection: work health, claim, proof rows, notes, acceptance, and the GIT pane with checkout, commits, and pull requests.
lookFor: Can you tell what is claimed, blocked, or proven without opening a hub?
Does the GIT pane compete with the task body?
Is the proof section scannable when there are several criteria?
scenes.keys: g source · k claims · m comments · P pull requests

scenes.title: Attention and control strip
scenes.state: Claims, block, aging, gaps, red checks
scenes.description: The plan tree with an expiring claim, a blocked task, aging work, a done row with an open criterion, and a failing pull-request check.
lookFor: Does the control strip name the reasons to intervene?
Are the glyphs and row colors distinguishable?
Does the health line match the rows below it?
scenes.keys: j/k select · space mark · c commands

scenes.title: Filtered tree
scenes.description: The tree filtered by text. Matching branches stay open, so the hits and their sibling context are both visible.
lookFor: Can you tell a filter is active without reading the status line?
Does showing full matching branches make the tree look unfiltered?
Should the filter be a prompt, an inline field, or both?

scenes.title: Narrow terminal
scenes.description: The shell at 78 columns: the overview hides, and the plan queue, plan review, agents, and git cards stack vertically.
lookFor: Is the compact layout still legible?
What information disappears first, and is that the right order?
Do wrapped rows lose their status glyphs?

scenes.title: Wide terminal
scenes.description: The shell at 170 columns with the timeline visible, showing how the side panes and the bottom timeline share the extra space.
lookFor: Does the wide layout use the space intentionally?
Should the timeline be always-on or opt-in at this width?
Is the preview line length comfortable?

scenes.title: Timeline
scenes.description: The timeline card with a milestone selected, keeping the milestone lane and its tasks while the rest of the plan stays quiet.
lookFor: Is the lane grammar readable without a legend?
Are start positions and missing lanes understandable?
Does the card crowd the tree at normal height?

scenes.title: Theme: void
scenes.description: The shell in the void theme, the high-contrast black palette for dark rooms.
lookFor: Are the accent colors still distinguishable?
Does the border contrast hold up?
Is the selected row obvious without color alone?

scenes.title: Theme: latte
scenes.description: The shell in the latte theme, the light palette for bright rooms and screen sharing.
lookFor: Does the light theme keep status colors legible?
Are borders and dim text still readable?
Is the diff and code text comfortable on light backgrounds?

scenes.title: Task without source
scenes.description: A task selection with no linked repository: the GIT pane explains the next action instead of going blank.
lookFor: Is the empty GIT pane useful or just noise?
Should an unlinked task hide the pane entirely?
Does the preview still explain why source is missing?

scenes.title: Criteria hub
scenes.description: The criteria hub for a plan: checklist rows, proof state, and a preview that names evidence and proving tasks.
lookFor: Is done/open mixed with pass/fail readable?
Does the preview explain what evidence exists?
Are the hub action hints discoverable?
scenes.keys: a add · e edit · p prove · l relate · d delete

scenes.title: Evidence hub
scenes.state: Criterion with pass and fail rows
scenes.description: The evidence hub for one criterion, with command, exit code, commit, task, and note for each proof row.
lookFor: Can you tell which row is the latest and whether it passes?
Is the command the most important field?
Does the list need grouping or a verdict column?
scenes.keys: p prove · o open · y copy

scenes.title: Questions hub
scenes.description: The questions hub: open questions that block readiness, a resolved question with its resolution, and the readiness note in the preview.
lookFor: Is the effect on readiness obvious?
Can you tell resolve from reopen?
Does the preview repeat the row too much?
scenes.keys: a add · x toggle · esc back

scenes.title: References hub
scenes.description: The references hub: read-only external links with provider, kind, title, and URL.
lookFor: Is the read-only nature of references clear?
Is the provider visible enough to trust the link?
Does open versus unlink need more separation?
scenes.keys: a link · o open · d unlink

scenes.title: Claims and touch-points hub
scenes.description: The claims hub for one task: holder, expiry, age, note, one overlapping lease, and the touch-point list.
lookFor: Can you see why a claim is risky?
Are renew, release, and force release distinguishable?
Does the expiry date need a relative time too?
scenes.keys: a claim · x renew · d release · D force

scenes.title: Sessions and handoffs hub
scenes.description: The sessions hub: actor, host, branch, age, idle time, summary, handoff, and the recent event trail.
lookFor: Can you tell which agent needs you?
Is idle time more useful than start time?
Is the handoff easy to find?
scenes.keys: a start · d end · x end

scenes.title: Comments and notes hub
scenes.state: Open comments and a handoff note
scenes.description: The comments hub: review comments, a handoff note, and the unresolved-only filter.
lookFor: Are comments and notes visually distinct?
Is the unresolved filter discoverable?
Can you tell who wrote what?
scenes.keys: a comment · n note · e edit · x resolve · u filter

scenes.title: Pull request hub
scenes.description: The pull request hub: cached state, base and head refs, checks, reviews, merge time, URL, and the refresh boundary.
lookFor: Is stale data marked clearly?
Does the user know refresh is the only network action?
Are checks and reviews scannable at a glance?
scenes.keys: a link · r refresh · d unlink · o open

scenes.title: Activity hub
scenes.description: The activity hub: actor, event, detail, and the row each event can jump back to.
lookFor: Can you reconstruct what changed without timestamps?
Is the actor filter visible enough?
Does every row need a jump target?
scenes.keys: f actor · K kind · enter jump

scenes.title: Commit selected
scenes.description: The source trail with a commit selected: repository, author, changed files, and a unified diff beside the tree.
lookFor: Is the tree-to-diff relationship obvious?
Does the diff need syntax color to be useful?
Are commit metadata and files in the right order?
scenes.keys: enter owner · o open · y copy · / filter

scenes.title: File selected
scenes.description: The source trail with one changed file selected: path, status, and the line-level diff.
lookFor: Can you tell which file and commit you are looking at?
Is the file hierarchy clear in the tree?
Should the diff own more of the screen?
scenes.keys: enter owner · o open · y copy

scenes.title: Source trail with no links
scenes.description: The source trail for a task with no linked checkout, commits, or pull requests.
lookFor: Does the empty state name the exact command to fix it?
Should the screen be reachable at all when there is no source?
Is the header summary useful when everything is zero?

scenes.title: Source filter
scenes.description: The source trail with the filter field open, matching commits, files, and pull requests.
lookFor: Is the filter field clearly temporary?
Does the tree show why rows disappeared?
Should filter and search be the same gesture as the tree?

scenes.title: New plan
scenes.description: The create-plan form: title, why, and what, with multiline fields for the definition.
lookFor: Does the form teach what a plan needs?
Are why and what too open-ended?
Is the primary action obvious?
scenes.keys: tab next · enter submit · esc cancel

scenes.title: New milestone
scenes.state: Create form scoped to a plan
scenes.description: The create-milestone form for one plan, with a title and a details field.
lookFor: Does the context line tell you which plan you are adding to?
Is the difference between a milestone and a task clear?
Does the placeholder ask for user value?
scenes.keys: tab next · enter submit · esc cancel

scenes.title: New task
scenes.state: Create form scoped to a milestone
scenes.description: The create-task form for one milestone, with a title and a details field.
lookFor: Does the details placeholder ask for approach and verification?
Is the parent milestone obvious?
Should the form suggest a commit slice?
scenes.keys: tab next · enter submit · esc cancel

scenes.title: Edit task
scenes.description: The edit-task form with existing text filled in, showing the edit variant of the create form.
lookFor: Does the title switch from New to Edit clearly?
Are long descriptions comfortable in the text area?
Is Save distinct from Cancel?
scenes.keys: tab next · enter save · esc cancel

scenes.title: Add criterion
scenes.description: The add-criterion prompt opened from a task selection.
lookFor: Does the FILTER heading fit an add-criterion prompt?
Does the title name the parent row?
Is one line enough for a good criterion?

scenes.title: Edit criterion
scenes.state: Text and completion in one dialog
scenes.description: The edit-criterion form with the criterion text and a done checkbox.
lookFor: Is the done checkbox the right control?
Should proof be visible while editing?
Is the dialog title enough context?
scenes.keys: tab next · enter submit · esc cancel

scenes.title: Link reference
scenes.description: The external reference form: URL, kind, and a short title.
lookFor: Is the type field understandable?
Should the app infer the provider from the URL?
Is a read-only reference clearly not a sync?
scenes.keys: tab next · enter link · esc cancel

scenes.title: Confirm delete
scenes.description: The first delete confirmation, with the parent and child warning.
lookFor: Is the safe choice focused by default?
Does the copy say what else disappears?
Is a second reason prompt too much friction?
scenes.keys: tab choose · enter confirm · esc cancel

scenes.title: Delete reason
scenes.description: The required reason prompt after the destructive confirmation.
lookFor: Does the two-step delete feel safer or slower?
Is the reason field required at the right moment?
Should the reason be visible in the feed?

scenes.title: Filter tree
scenes.description: The tree text filter prompt, with an empty value clearing the filter.
lookFor: Does the prompt explain that empty clears?
Should filtering be inline in the tree?
Is the scope (whole tree) obvious?

scenes.title: Approve plan
scenes.description: The approval prompt that records why a scope is approved after drift.
lookFor: Does the FILTER heading fit an approval prompt?
Does the title explain why a reason is required after drift?
Should the diff be shown before this prompt?

scenes.title: Start session
scenes.description: The start-session prompt with an optional branch.
lookFor: Is it clear that the branch is optional?
Does starting a session need a plan context line?
Who is the actor, and should the form say?

scenes.title: Add comment
scenes.description: The add-comment prompt attached to one task.
lookFor: Is the parent row named?
Does comment versus note need an explanation?
Is @mention support discoverable?

scenes.title: Add note
scenes.description: The add-note prompt for a handoff or decision.
lookFor: Is note versus comment clear?
Does the placeholder imply permanence?
Should notes be immutable?

scenes.title: Link pull request
scenes.description: The prompt to attach a pull request URL to the selected row.
lookFor: Does the placeholder show the expected URL shape?
Is an invalid URL handled clearly?
Should linking be possible without a URL?

scenes.title: Filter activity by actor
scenes.state: Filter prompt with blank meaning all
scenes.description: The activity hub actor filter, where blank input clears the filter.
lookFor: Is blank-for-all clear?
Should actor filters be a picker?
Is the filter state visible after applying?

scenes.title: Export plan
scenes.description: The Markdown export picker: destination path, folder tree, filename, error line, and actions.
lookFor: Is the destination editable and clear?
Does the folder tree earn the space?
Is overwrite protection visible before you press Export?
scenes.keys: tab move · enter export · esc cancel

scenes.title: Overwrite export
scenes.description: The overwrite confirmation that appears when the chosen export path already exists.
lookFor: Is the full target path shown?
Is overwrite styled as dangerous enough?
Could the picker prevent this earlier?
scenes.keys: tab choose · enter overwrite · esc cancel

scenes.title: Update lpui
scenes.description: The update screen with an installed and a newer version, plus the download action.
lookFor: Does the screen explain when the update applies?
Is the install method relevant to the user?
Is Later the easy exit?

scenes.title: Plan diff
scenes.description: The read-only plan diff overlay: summary counts, each changed row, and the recorded reason.
lookFor: Can you tell what changed without the code?
Do the change glyphs need a legend?
Is the reason attached to the right row?

scenes.title: Help
scenes.description: The help overlay shared by `?`, `lpui help`, and every screen.
lookFor: Is the OBSERVE/WRITE split useful?
Are the groups in the right order?
Does the key column scan well?

scenes.title: Command palette
scenes.description: The command palette with every command, section headers, key hints, and disabled context.
lookFor: Can you find a command by intent?
Do section headers help or add noise?
Is the mode split visible enough?
scenes.keys: type search · enter run · esc cancel

scenes.title: Filtered command palette
scenes.description: The palette after typing a query, with the result count and the first runnable command highlighted.
lookFor: Does the count help?
Are matching aliases visible?
Is the disabled context explained?
scenes.keys: type search · enter run · esc cancel

scenes.title: CLI help
scenes.description: The task-grouped help at the shell, the same source as the `?` overlay.
lookFor: Does the shell help match the overlay?
Is the key column aligned?
Are deprecated keys visible but quiet?

scenes.title: CLI list
scenes.description: The plan tree with status glyphs, progress, and the agent-facing view.
lookFor: Is the tree scannable in a terminal transcript?
Do the glyphs survive a monochrome terminal?
Is progress easy to compare across rows?

scenes.title: CLI show
scenes.description: One plan's why, what, criteria, and children in the shell.
lookFor: Does the show output match the overview?
Is the hierarchy clear without color?
Is the output too long for one screen?

scenes.title: CLI stats
scenes.description: Flow health at the shell: WIP, cycle time, throughput, aging, stale work, reopened work, claims, and blocked tasks.
lookFor: Is the metric vocabulary explained?
Which numbers need a sparkline or trend?
Does this belong in the TUI?

scenes.title: CLI review
scenes.description: The deterministic review packet handed to an agent.
lookFor: Does the packet read like a handoff?
Is the order right for a reviewer?
Does it duplicate the show output too much?

scenes.title: CLI feed
scenes.description: The activity feed at the shell, with actor and event detail.
lookFor: Can you reconstruct a session from the feed?
Is actor noise or signal?
Should the feed group related events?

scenes.title: Setup wizard
scenes.description: The first-run setup wizard: where plans live, which agents get the skill, and the review of everything installation will write.
lookFor: Does the wizard explain the placement tradeoff?
Are detected agents obvious?
Is the review step scannable before writing?
